archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-06.4 Support and Engage Users
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
Once the data is available, user support becomes essential. In this step, the organization provides guidance, documentation, and helpdesk services to assist users in understanding and using the data correctly. Users may have questions about definitions, methods, or technical details — these are addressed through FAQs, tutorials, and direct communication channels. For researchers and professional users, training or workshops may be offered. This step ensures that users not only access the data, but also interpret and apply it correctly, strengthening trust in official statistics.
Value created: Informed, confident users who can correctly understand and apply statistical data.
